name: novabay
description: Read-only eBay seller dashboard: live listings, bids, watchers, sales and orders, plus a skill that builds a local NovaBay command-deck dashboard.

EBAY_CLIENT_ID.title: eBay App ID (Client ID)
EBAY_CLIENT_ID.description: Production App ID from developer.ebay.com. Leave blank with NOVABAY_DEMO=1.

EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: eBay user refresh token
EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: User refresh token for your own seller account (see README).

NOVABAY_DEMO.title: Demo mode
NOVABAY_DEMO.description: Set to 1 to return built-in sample data with no eBay account.
